blocks.title: AI 业务、客户与品牌诊断
blocks.focus: 整理产品、价格、FAQ、案例、客户评论、Logo、图片和已有内容；提取客户问题、购买动机、顾虑与品牌不一致。
blocks.focusEn: Collect the offer, pricing, FAQs, proof, customer feedback, logo, images and existing content; extract audience questions, motivations, objections and brand inconsistencies.

blocks.title: AI Brand Kit 与视觉模板
blocks.focus: 锁定可公开事实、品牌语气、色板、字体、图片风格、构图、CTA 和禁用规则，并完成常用社媒模板。
blocks.focusEn: Lock public facts, brand voice, colour, type, image style, composition, CTA and prohibited rules, then build reusable social templates.
blocks.output: Brand Source of Truth + AI Brand Kit + Social Templates
blocks.outputEn: Brand Source of Truth + AI Brand Kit + social templates

blocks.title: AI 海报、印刷品与周边设计
blocks.focus: 围绕一个真实产品或促销主题完成主视觉、数字海报，并延展一项传单、菜单、优惠券、包装或周边；检查尺寸和交付文件。
blocks.focusEn: Use one real product or promotion to create a key visual and digital poster, then extend it into one flyer, menu, voucher, packaging or merchandise item and check the handoff files.
blocks.output: Key Visual + Poster + One Print or Merchandise Asset
blocks.outputEn: Key visual + poster + one print or merchandise asset

blocks.title: 选择主平台与内容支柱
blocks.titleEn: Choose Primary Platforms and Content Pillars
blocks.focus: 按业务目标和实际能力选择平台，建立教育、证明、产品、幕后和转化支柱。
blocks.focusEn: Choose sustainable platforms and define education, proof, product, behind-the-scenes and conversion pillars.

blocks.title: 搭建 30 天内容日历
blocks.focus: 为每条内容写清客户问题、形式、证据、CTA、素材和负责人。
blocks.focusEn: Define the customer problem, format, proof, CTA, assets and owner for each item.

blocks.title: 完成首批 12 条社媒内容
blocks.focus: 完成 Hook、正文、CTA 和配图 Brief，并删除套话、重复结构和无法证明的数字。
blocks.focusEn: Complete hooks, body copy, CTA and visual briefs, then remove filler, repetition and unsupported figures.

blocks.title: 把 Master Content 改成平台原生版本
blocks.titleEn: Adapt Master Content into Native Platform Versions
blocks.focus: 为选定平台分别重写 Hook、正文、CTA、标签和画面建议。
blocks.focusEn: Rewrite hooks, body copy, CTA, tags and visual direction for each selected platform.

blocks.title: 制作 Carousel、单图、Story 与封面
blocks.titleEn: Create the Carousel, Social Images, Stories and Cover
blocks.focus: 使用前三小时建立的 Brand Kit 和模板完成视觉资产，检查尺寸、裁切安全区和移动端可读性。
blocks.focusEn: Use the Brand Kit and templates from the first three hours to produce the visual set and check dimensions, crop-safe areas and mobile readability.
blocks.outputEn: One carousel + three images + two stories + cover

blocks.title: 确定三条视频任务与 Hook
blocks.titleEn: Define Three Video Jobs and Hooks
blocks.focus: 分别选择教育、证明或促销目标，避免三条视频重复。
blocks.focusEn: Choose education, proof or promotion jobs so the three videos serve different purposes.

blocks.title: 完成脚本、分镜与素材清单
blocks.titleEn: Finish Scripts, Storyboards and Asset Lists
blocks.focus: 写清旁白、镜头、屏幕文字、素材、CTA、声音和字幕要求。
blocks.focusEn: Specify narration, shots, on-screen text, assets, CTA, sound and caption requirements.

blocks.title: 组装短视频并完成发布前 QA
blocks.titleEn: Assemble the Short Videos and Run Pre-publish QA
blocks.focus: 完成竖版视频、字幕和封面，检查前三秒、音量、品牌、事实、版权与导出规格。
blocks.focusEn: Finish vertical videos, captions and covers, then check the opening, audio, brand, facts, rights and export settings.
blocks.outputEn: Three short videos + captions + covers + QA

blocks.title: AI 项目与公司任务管理
blocks.focus: 把营销、销售、客户跟进和日常运营目标拆成优先级任务，明确负责人、截止时间、依赖、状态和 Definition of Done。
blocks.focusEn: Turn marketing, sales, customer follow-up and daily operations into prioritised tasks with owners, due dates, dependencies, states and a Definition of Done.
blocks.output: AI Project Brief + Prioritised Backlog + Company Task Board
blocks.outputEn: AI project brief + prioritised backlog + company task board

blocks.title: AI 执行、跟进与复盘
blocks.focus: 让 AI 整理会议与消息、提取行动项、更新进度、发现阻塞并生成周报；最后完成 Review、Retro 和下一轮计划。
blocks.focusEn: Use AI to turn meetings and messages into actions, update progress, surface blockers and produce a weekly review, then set the next operating cycle.
blocks.output: AI Action Tracker + Weekly Review + Reusable Management Workflow
blocks.outputEn: AI action tracker + weekly review + reusable management workflow

pausedExtensions.noteEn: Not part of the core course. It may return later as a separate campaign workshop covering the campaign brief, master, email, landing page and channel pack.
